name: Dancing with the Stars
description: Celebrities and their professional dance partners strut their stuff on the dancefloor. Each week, one couple is voted off by the public and a panel of judges. And so it goes week after week until just one star remains.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: There’s sure to be glitz, glamour and a touch of drama as Australia’s favourite returning celebrities and wildcards take to the dance floor in the hope of impressing the judges and surviving elimination.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The returning stars, the dazzling costumes, and the dancing are back as we see Group B take to the dance floor to survive elimination, while Group A watch the spectacle from the DWTS sky box.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The hits keep coming, with Group A celebrities returning to the dancefloor for another night of glitz and glamour, and one step closer to reclaiming their spot as the ultimate DWTS All Star.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: It’s the first of our trips down memory lane with some of our celebrities revisiting a dance from their previous appearance.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Our first dance marathon features couples dancing the Lindy Hop to earn points. It's also another trip down memory lane for three couples as they compete to make the grand finale.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: It’s all about the glitz and glamour for the marathon tonight as our all-stars bump and grind their way to the glorious disco music of the 70s.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: This is it! The Grand Finale. The remaining six couples freestyle their way through the final night of competition with the coveted Mirrorball Trophy on the line. Who wins?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Dancing With The Stars All-Stars is back with hosts Daryl Somers and Sonya Kruger. Ten returning All-Stars are joined by four Wildcards.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As the second group take to the dancefloor, two couples grab perfect scores for their first dance.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: With a place in the semi-finals up for grabs, Group 1 is back on the dance floor to show their wares, dancing the Viennese waltz.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: This time, it's Group 2’s turn to head to the dancefloor, looking to try and book their place in the semi-finals.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In the first semi-final, five of our celebs strut their stuff, hoping to make it to the DWTS Grand Finale 2022.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: In the second semi-final, the final places of the DWTS Grand Finale 2022 are up for grabs.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: In the 2022 Grand Finale, six couples are left to battle it out for the esteemed mirror ball trophy.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The first group of Dancing Stars enter the ballroom for 2023, including Comedian Mary Coustas, Actress Emily Weir, “Chase Australia’s” Issa Schultz, AFL legend Gavin Wanganeen and Singer Paulini.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Our 2nd group of Dancing Stars enter the ballroom for 2023, including acclaimed actress Virginia Gay, Human Nature’s Phil Burton, Better Homes & Gardens’ Charlie Albone & actress Christie Whelan-Browne.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Our first group of Dancing stars return, and so does elimination. One couple will blow the competition away with a perfect score, while another makes a shocking decision to leave.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Our second group of Dancing stars, including Human Nature’s Phil Burton, actress Virginia Gay and Better Homes & Gardens’ Charlie Albone, return to the dancefloor and face their first Elimination.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: It’s the first Semi-Final. Six Dancing Stars from our first group, including “Chase Australia’s” Super-nerd Issa Schultz and comedian Mary Coustas, fight to secure a spot in the Grand Finale.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: It’s the second Semi-Final. Six Dancing Stars from our second group, including Human Nature’s Phil Burton and actress Virginia Gay, will battle it out for just three spots in the Grand Finale.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Six Stars, including Human Nature’s Phil Burton, actress Virginia Gay and Home and Away’s Emily Weir, have made it to the Dancing With the Stars Finale. Who will win the Mirrorball trophy?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Our first group of dancing stars enter the ballroom, including actress Lisa McCune, AFL champ Ben Cousins, SAS tough guy Ant Middleton, Home & Away’s James Stewart and home cooking star Julie Goodwin.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Our second group of dancing stars enter the ballroom for 2024, including recording star Sammy Jade, Olympic gold medallist Nova Peris, Taste of Australia’s Hayden Quinn, and AFL legend Shane Crawford.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The first group of stars return to the dancefloor for the first elimination. One celebrity will rise above the rest as the others fight to avoid the dreaded dance-off to determine who will leave.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Our second group of dancing stars will face their first dance-off & elimination. The studio audience will now be voting alongside expert judges. Who will leave the competition this week?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: It’s a huge night of “Dancing with the Stars” as both teams merge. Ten outstanding dancing stars will take to the dancefloor, but there’s no dance-offs; instead, it’s a double elimination.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: It’s finals time for “Dancing with the Stars 2024”, and just eight celebrities and their professional partners remain to fight it out to secure one of the final five spots in the Grand Finale.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Five Dancing Stars have made it to the glittering “Dancing With the Stars” Grand Finale. Who will be the “Dancing with the Stars” Ballroom Champion for 2024?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Our first group of dancing stars enter the ballroom, including actor Rebecca Gibney, AFL champ Trent Cotchin, radio host Brittany Hockley, Olympians Susie O'Neill & Harry Garside & Michael Usher.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Our second group of Dancing Stars enter the ballroom for 2025, including comedians Shuan Micallef and Felicity Ward as well as television and radio host Osher Gunsberg.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Our stars continue to impress the expert international judging panel, comprising Craig Revel-Horwood, Helen Richey, Sharna Burgess, and Mark Wilson.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Our second group of celebrities hit the ballroom floor once again. Tonight, these celebrities will dig their heels in to impress the expert judges and avoid elimination.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: It's a royal showdown for the Kings and Queens special! Trent Cotchin, Brittany Hockley, Harry Garside, Michael Usher and Rebecca Gibney bring their best moves in a bid to stay in the competition.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Kings and Queens Week continues, as the final five celebrities, Shaun Micallef, Osher Günsberg, Mia Fevola, Kyle Shilling and Felicity Ward battle to keep their place in the competition.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: It's Semi-Finals time! Trent Cotchin, Brittany Hockley, Harry Garside & Michael Usher give it their all to win over expert judges and the live studio audience for a spot in the Grand Finale.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Shaun Micallef, Kyle Shilling, Felicity Ward and Mia Fevola hit the dance floor in the Semi Finals, hoping to escape elimination and score a spot in the Grand Finale.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: It's grand finale time! Six finalists dance for the mirrorball trophy, with judges' scores and Australia's vote deciding who takes home the ultimate prize.
